item-404-empty-body.title: A missing item returns 404 with an empty body, so the not-found message never renders
item-404-empty-body.expected: "Sorry, we couldn't find any such product." on /item/<missing id>
item-404-empty-body.actual: HTTP 404, empty body; Chromium shows net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE

catalog-create-missing-name-500.title: POST /api/catalog/items without a name fails in the database and returns an undocumented 500
catalog-create-missing-name-500.expected: 400, as the Catalog API's OpenAPI document says
catalog-create-missing-name-500.actual: 500, undocumented: the missing name fails in the database

identity-login-missing-assets.title: Identity's login page requests bootstrap and jquery files that return 404
identity-login-missing-assets.expected: The login page's stylesheets and scripts load
